purpose: Validate that the already-used HA10 event-window, matched-noise, response-correction and Welch pipeline can recover broadband event-linked T-phase energy inside the hydrophone's nominal passband. This is a pipeline positive control only and has zero authority to reverse, weaken or reinterpret the frozen 119-Hz negative result.

control_frequency_contract.selection_basis: Instrument-defined interior passband control: 10 Hz is the frozen response-calibration reference and 80 Hz remains well inside the documented 1-100 Hz hydrophone band. No frequency peak observed in the completed 119-Hz run was used to choose this band.

spectral_estimator.broadband_power: trapezoidal integral of PSD over the fully predeclared 10-80 Hz interval

predeclared_statistics.raw_event_vs_noise_snr_db: 10*log10(raw 10-80 Hz event integrated power / median raw 10-80 Hz integrated power across the two frozen matched-noise windows)
predeclared_statistics.corrected_event_vs_noise_snr_db: 10*log10(response-corrected 10-80 Hz event integrated power / median corrected 10-80 Hz integrated power across the two frozen matched-noise windows)
predeclared_statistics.diagnostic_subband_snr_db: same event-vs-noise calculation in all three fixed subbands; never select the strongest subband for admission

claim_ceiling: A PASS validates only that this frozen HA10 processing path can recover event-linked broadband in-band energy against matched noise for at least three catalog events on both stations. It does not validate 119 Hz, identify a source, support Love-Edem, establish an underwater structure, or reverse the immutable negative 119-Hz receipt. A FAIL means the measurement pipeline requires investigation before further spectral inference.
